Also interviewed backstage this same night alongside Edward, sparring with Allison Ivey over the Youngbloods and the World Tag Team Championship picture. Entered the Tower of Doom on 15 November 2003 alongside Team Canada, briefly brawling with teammate Bob Jablonski mid-match; on the losing side as the Sons of Cacaphony escaped the cage first and won the UWF North American Tag Team Championship.
